rationale: Z59. An edge SOURCE must name a symbol the index publishes. Three classes of declaration are deliberately NOT published — a member of a container written inside a function or test body, a member of an anonymous container, and a member of a container nested in another unpublished one (Z22 / the C negative contract: such a type has no file-scope identity) — and the three edge passes each took the nearest function/test identifier as the source name without asking. Measured through production `parseFile` over the FULL 3,834-file corpus (validation/m14/fixtures/zig/dangling-source-census.ts, draw sha256:8e174b8d28069b5144e92d9e32a942fc75258a8480fdb61af92fa54854af68f3 at 200 files): 11,332 of 224,599 calls+uses+instantiates edges = 5.05% carried a source naming an unpublished declaration, and the class residual — a dangling source no tree declaration explains — was 0, so this is the whole population rather than a sample of it. Overturning reading: a non-zero residual in that census. The fixture's trap is a GENERIC FUNCTION returning an anonymous struct, so every method in it is an unpublished member; the pre-fix analyzer emitted `uses push -> items`, `calls push -> reserve` and `uses reserve -> len`, each naming a caller the store cannot hold. The post-fix reading attributes them to the nearest PUBLISHED scope, which here is `Stack`. The named-test half is asserted too because the fix must not have reverted Z39: `test namedScope` still attributes to `namedScope`, and no symbol exists for a test either — that residual class is a declared limitation with its own measured count, not an oversight, so both sides of the boundary are pinned here.

expectRelationships.note: Z66: `std.debug.assert(...)` at :56 is a read through a name this file binds by @import, so the edge names the receiver. The SOURCE spelling `debug` alone is forbidden below: the unpublished-scope question this fixture pins — which scope an edge may be attributed to — is unaffected, but a receiver-less target is indistinguishable from a local `debug`.
Z39, asserted so the Z59 fix cannot have reverted it: a named test is a scope with a name
